design_concept: Industrial Blueprint & Heavy Machinery Art Direction

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-oswald font-bold tracking-tighter uppercase text-slate-900
hierarchy.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-oswald font-bold tracking-tight uppercase text-slate-900
hierarchy.h3: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-oswald font-medium uppercase text-slate-800
hierarchy.label: text-xs sm:text-sm font-ibm-plex-mono tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-blue-700 font-semibold

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200. Use border-blue-900/10 for structural grid lines.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Industrial brutalist: shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(15,23,42,1)] for key cards and buttons.
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp, absolute precision. rounded-none on all components to emphasize heavy engineering.
visual_enhancers.corner_markers: Add small crosshairs or '+' signs at the corners of main sections for a technical drawing feel.

layouts.general: The Swiss Grid: Use a strict 12-column bento grid for data and portfolios. Generous padding (py-24 or py-32). Left-align everything. Use explicit section numbering (e.g., [ 01 / ABOUT ]).
layouts.hero: Split cinematic layout. Left: massive typographic statement ('PRECISION DIE CASTING MACHINERY') with technical metadata. Right: Image grid/slider with parallax motion.
layouts.about: Data-heavy bento grid. Call out '1998', '25+ YEARS', 'ISO CERTIFIED', '2700 TON CAPACITY' in large typography.
layouts.products_services: Technical list layout. Hovering over a service reveals a floating image (hydraulic cylinders, power packs) using Framer Motion.
layouts.portfolio_projects: Large image cards highlighting '1350 Ton Refurbishing', 'Missile Launching Pads'. Use mono-spaced font for stats (e.g., '21-DAY TURNAROUND').
layouts.founder: Editorial layout. Large portrait of Nanjappa K.K. overlapping a large typographic quote. High contrast.
layouts.contact: Technical form layout resembling a blueprint document. Clear inputs with sharp borders.

components.button_primary: bg-blue-700 text-white font-ibm-plex-mono uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-4 hover:bg-slate-900 transition-colors duration-300 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(15,23,42,1)] active:translate-y-[2px] active:translate-x-[2px] active:shadow-none
components.button_secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-slate-900 text-slate-900 font-ibm-plex-mono uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-4 hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300
components.card: border border-slate-200 bg-white p-8 relative overflow-hidden group hover:border-blue-500 transition-colors. Include small corner markers (+).
components.navigation: Sticky crystal glass header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200. Technical minimalist links. Use data-testid attributes for links.
components.footer: Deep Navy background (bg-slate-900) with white/slate-300 text. Massive typography for contact info.

motion.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling. This is MANDATORY for the premium feel.
motion.reveal: Use Framer Motion. Elements should stagger fade-up (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> 1) on scroll.
motion.image_hover: Images inside cards should scale up slightly (scale-105) on hover with a slow transition-transform duration-700 ease-out.
motion.marquee: Use a slow, text-based marquee (react-fast-marquee) for the client list (TVS, HAL Aerospace, BDL, etc.) in uppercase mono font.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject Google Fonts into index.html: Oswald (400,500,600,700), IBM Plex Sans (400,500,600), IBM Plex Mono (400,500,600).
Configure tailwind.config.js to extend fonts: { oswald: ['Oswald', 'sans-serif'], 'ibm-plex-sans': ['"IBM Plex Sans"', 'sans-serif'], 'ibm-plex-mono': ['"IBM Plex Mono"', 'monospace'] }.
Build a Multi-Page layout using React Router if necessary, or a single-page long scrolling marketing site with sticky nav sections.
Use standard raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts (Hero, About, Portfolio). Only use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions like Forms or Dialogs.
Implement the 'Blueprint Grid' background in the global CSS or as a Tailwind utility.
Do NOT center align text. Keep an editorial, left-aligned, highly structured grid approach.
Add `data-testid` to all actionable items (links, buttons, form inputs).
Maintain high contrast. Ensure all text over images or dark backgrounds is legible.
Build the Contact form with real input fields and a submit button.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
DO NOT center align the app container.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder URLs. Use the provided image URLs.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
